brief.claim: The insecticide lowers invertebrate density: the mean density in treated tanks is lower than in control tanks, and a Welch two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: invertebrates per litre counted in each of the water samples taken from each tank
whether the tank received the insecticide

brief.sizes: tanks = 8; samples = 10 (density: 8 x 10 = 80 values; treated: 8 values)
